source_snapshot.procedure: Power on server and visually check BMC heartbeat LED.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY with board-specific visual oracle and video evidence.

old_problem: The exact LED/designator, readiness state, color/cadence tolerance and observation window are project-specific and absent; software health cannot substitute for a real visual result.
disposition_reason: ED-09 expressly assigns physical LED observation to a human, while ED-03 allows board mapping and SPEC values as runtime prerequisites. The method, safety boundary, visual evidence and PASS/FAIL comparison are fully defined without guessing the project color/cadence; missing values block execution only.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2262 and 2263, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve power-on and physical heartbeat LED operation-against-SPEC coverage.
Bind board revision, exact LED designator/location and AC/host/BMC readiness state before observation.
A qualified observer captures SUT-linked timestamped photo/video long enough and at adequate frame rate to measure color, frequency, duty and stability.
BMC logs/readiness may correlate state but never replace the physical light or visual evidence.
No power action, chassis access, LED observation, log clearing or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Manual BMC heartbeat LED color/cadence verification
test_case.purpose: Verify the correct physical onboard heartbeat LED visibly exhibits the project-specified color and temporal pattern in the exact BMC readiness state.
required_package: Board revision and heartbeat LED designator/location map
SPEC color, solid/blink pattern, frequency/duty tolerance and observation duration
Safe viewing fixture/PPE/ESD method and adequate video frame rate
test_case.test_command: A qualified observer safely identifies the SUT and LED, places the platform in the approved power/readiness state, records timestamped video for at least the configured duration, measures visible color/cadence/duty/stability and correlates BMC readiness/logs without touching energized internals.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped physical LED is visible and its measured color, solid/blink mode, frequency, duty cycle and stability remain within every signed SPEC tolerance throughout the observation window at the approved readiness state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires bound SPEC values and real SUT-linked visual evidence meeting all tolerances. Missing values block execution, not review. Software health alone, wrong LED, inadequate frame rate/duration or out-of-tolerance light behavior is FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE as defined by the evidence defect.
safety_gate: Qualified observer and safe guarded visibility only.
Do not touch energized internals or remove guarding without approved procedure.
Confirm LED/SUT identity and camera timing capability.
Preserve baseline logs; no log clear or inferred visual result.
expected_evidence: Signed readiness state and visual SPEC
test_case.recovery: No indicator control is changed by this observation; on unsafe visibility or ambiguous video stop and re-establish an approved viewing setup rather than opening or approaching energized hardware.

source_conflict.reason: Source consistently requires a physical SPEC-based heartbeat indication.

blocked.reason: The manual method is complete; board/SPEC values and safe visibility are runtime gates.
